reasoning: The question asks about week-over-week change in the 5-year forward inflation expectation rate (T5YIFR) from March 15 to March 22, 2026. This is essentially asking whether a daily market-derived measure will increase over one week. Historical analysis of such series shows roughly 50% probability of weekly increases due to random walk behavior. The evidence shows US inflation expectations have been moderately elevated but gradually declining (University of Michigan 5-year expectations fell from 3.4% to 3.3% in Feb 2026). With no strong directional catalyst evident for this specific week, I estimate near-baseline probability.
